description: This bundle contains 2 items! One Ryobi A99HT2 Door Hinge Installation Kit/Mortiser Template as well as one Ryobi A99DLK4 Wood and Metal Door Lock Installation Kit. Purchasing this all-in-one Ryobi Door Installation kit will make mortising a breeze! The hinge kit, perfect for home improvement projects, attaches snugly to any standard sized door with the built-in plastic clamp, eliminating rocking or other movements while you rout that perfect square or rounded hinge mortise. You don’t need to be worried about lacking the right bit for the job, because we have a routing bit included in this system so you can get down to business ASAP! Be even more confident with the widths and depths of your cuts thanks to the onboard adjustment tool and bit depth gauge. Using a smaller tool to complete your renovation or DIY project? Use the removable front guide to support your chisels and compact routers! Be prepared for easy deadlock and lockset installation with the Ryobi Wood and Metal Door Lock Installation Kit! The template fits snugly on standard sized wood or light metal doors. Align the auto strike locator with striker plate without measurements being needed. Keep it in place by driving the screws into the latch bore area. This will keep the template steady for when it’s time to bore out holes. Be sure your measurements of the main hole from the edge of the door are accurate by using a built in adjuster. Set it to your preferred length and you are ready to roll. Attach the arbor and pilot bit to the 2-1/8-inch hole saw. Attach this to your favorite drill and create a clean cut hole for your locksets. Drilling out the latch bore is just as easy! Simply attach the 1-inch hole saw to your drill or use the wood spade bit and use the template again. Continue by assembling your hardware. It’s as simple as that! No more worrying about incorrect angles. These Ryobi products are go-to for your door hinge and lock needs.
